body.text:
Can an AI voice actually outperform a human pro?

In this webinar session, Troy Stein challenges his long-held belief: that nothing can outperform a high-quality microphone paired with a strong human performance.

To test that assumption, four versions of the same video were created:

Human voice + high-quality microphone
Human voice + low-quality microphone
High-quality AI voice
Lower-quality AI voice

The videos were shared with viewers around the world and the data told an unexpected story.

The results were surprising, and opened up Troy's mind to the power of AI voices and avatars. 

Sign up for the webinar here: https://bit.ly/PowerofAudiateAIVoicesandAvatars

#Camtasia #AI #Mic #Videoeditor

The results from viewers around the world surprised me, and in this session, I’m sharing why I opened my mind to the power of AI voices and avatars. 

Together we will walk through Audiate's paid features and I’ll show you how to achieve higher quality results!
